source.notes: Rigid FR-4, 2 layers (JLCPCB's 1-layer boards drill 0.3 mm and up and have their own rows). Each rule names the row it comes from; rules marked as the author's choice are defaults, not limits. The options are JLCPCB's choices that change a limit; their defaults (recommended values, 1 oz outer copper, green mask, standard drilling) live in this file. The id still says 1oz because boards pin it; the profile covers 1 oz and 2 oz outer copper (the Outer copper weight option). Under the recommended values the smallest drill is JLCPCB's preferred 0.2 mm via hole, so boards with 0.15–0.2 mm vias get a finding there and not under the absolute minimum. Re-read the page before ordering: JLCPCB changes it.

drill_files.source: The capabilities page (read 2026-11-11) gives hole tolerances (Drilling, "Hole size Tolerance": "Through-holes: +0.13 / -0.08 mm") and finished sizes ("e.g. for the 0.6mm hole size, the finished hole size between 0.52mm to 0.73mm is acceptable.") but does not say whether drill files list finished or drilled sizes.

options.name: JLCPCB values
options.source: JLCPCB publishes a recommended value and a minimum for three rows (read 2026-11-14): Traces, "PTH annular ring": "1 oz: Recommended 0.25 mm or above; absolute minimum 0.18 mm"; "PTH to Track": "0.35mm is recommended, minimum 0.28mm"; Drilling, "Min. Via hole size/diameter": "0.15/0.25mm", "② Preferred Min. Via hole size: 0.2mm". Every other row gives one value, used under both. Not an order option: which of JLCPCB's two values the board is held to. The default is the recommended value.

options.name: Outer copper weight
options.source: Finished Outer Layer Copper: "2-layer: 1 oz / 2 oz / 2.5 oz / 3.5 oz / 4.5oz" (read 2026-11-14). JLCPCB publishes track, annular ring and soldermask limits for 1 oz and 2 oz only (2.5–4.5 oz give track and spacing only), so only those two are offered. The page gives no thickness: 35 µm an ounce per square foot (IPC-4562 nominal 34.8 µm, rounded as fabricators quote it; library/stackups). The board's top and bottom foils follow the choice. The default is 1 oz, the standard order.

options.name: Solder mask colour

choices.name: Green, red, yellow, blue or purple

options.source: Soldermask, "Soldermask bridge", 1 oz: "Min. pad spacing: 0.10 mm (green, red, yellow, blue, purple)", "Min. pad spacing: 0.13 mm (black, white)" (read 2026-11-14). The default is green, the colour group the profile's 0.10 mm comes from.

options.name: Smallest drill

choices.name: 0.1 mm (board 1 mm or thinner, ENIG or OSP finish)

options.source: Drilling, "Drill Diameter": "0.15 – 6.3 mm (0.1mm microvias only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required)"; "Min. drill diameter for 2- or more-layer PCBs is 0.1 mm (more costly!)" (read 2026-11-14). Choosing 0.1 mm sets neither the board thickness nor the finish: order both.
